page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.vgn6i-m4-vws.xlarge is a virtual workstation instance within the GPU-accelerated family, designed for graphics-driven applications and small-scale visual computing. Powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, the instance supplies 4 virtual CPUs derived from 2 dedicated physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system includes 23 GB of system RAM, providing 5.75 GB per vCPU, paired with a fractional NVIDIA T4 GPU offering a 0.25 slice of physical hardware and 4 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance operates under the KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps and contains no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for operating system and data requirements.

Benchmark results place the computational and memory throughput of the host CPU in modest brackets relative to modern cloud infrastructure. The instance recorded a Geekbench single-core score of 904.0 and a multi-core score of 2011.0, reflecting bottom-decile CPU execution metrics typical of older Skylake-era microarchitectures. Memory bandwidth registered 19.82 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 18.77 GB/sec for writes. PassMark CPU testing yielded 3597.24 points, while Redis throughput reached 2.82 million operations per second. Hardware acceleration benchmarks highlight support for small-model LLM inference, achieving 233.71 tokens per second during prompt ingestion and 64.28 tokens per second during generation on a 135M model, though larger language models exceed the capacity of the 4 GB VRAM partition.

The fractional GPU allocation provides a cost-efficient alternative to dedicating an entire enterprise GPU for low-overhead graphical tasks. By slicing the NVIDIA T4 into a 4 GB partition, the instance delivers hardware-accelerated rasterization and compute without the expense of full-die resource reservations. The primary architectural tradeoff is limited CPU IPC performance and constrained memory bandwidth alongside the lack of local scratch disks. As a result, the ecs.vgn6i-m4-vws.xlarge is best matched with virtual desktop infrastructure, remote CAD design, lightweight 3D visualization, basic video transcoding, and small-scale AI model inference.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.vgn6i-m4-vws.xlarge is a virtual workstation instance engineered for graphics workloads and entry-level GPU processing. It features 4 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz across 2 physical cores, paired with 23 GB of system memory. Graphics acceleration is provided by a fractional 0.25 share of an NVIDIA T4 GPU equipped with 4 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance includes 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth and operates without onboard local storage, relying on network-attached storage volumes. Benchmark data indicates modest host CPU and memory throughput, reflecting legacy architecture metrics, while the GPU slice capably handles small machine learning pipelines such as 135M parameter inference at 64.28 generation tokens per second. Offering a cost-conscious entry into hardware acceleration, the instance is appropriate for remote virtual desktops, basic CAD workstations, UI rendering, and lightweight neural network inference.
